chunks: Abān narrated from Abī Maryam, from Abī ʿAbdillāh عليه السلام, who said:

He was asked about a man who emancipates his bondwoman by tadbīr, whether he may have relations with her if he wishes, or marry her off, or sell her service during his lifetime. He said: "Yes, whichever of that he wishes, he may do."

key_terms.يَبِيعُ خِدْمَتَهَا: he sells her service or labor

ai.seo_question: What is the ruling on a mudabbar bondwoman during the master's lifetime?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling concerning a bondwoman designated for emancipation after her master's death through tadbīr. It states that during his lifetime, the owner retains authority over her in the ways mentioned, including relations, marrying her off, and selling her service.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications:
Hadith.3462 - Aban narrated from Abu Maryam, from Abu Abdullah (as), who was asked about a man who made his bondwoman mudabbar (to be freed after his death).
Imam (as) was asked: "Can he have relations with her if he wishes, or marry her off, or sell her service during his lifetime?"
Imam (as) said: "Yes, he may do any of these if he wishes."
